title: Fully learned multimodal physical control with optional physics-law prior
question: Can a fully learned multimodal persistent controller infer hidden motion from history and choose the correct control action, and does adding only physical-law priors improve that capability?
hypothesis: A learned temporal state should infer history-dependent motion and solve the control task. A conservation/kinematics prior may improve generalization without encoding task-specific addressing or operator logic.

arms.name: learned_data_only
arms.intervention: fully learned multimodal recurrent controller trained only with action cross-entropy

arms.name: learned_physics_prior
arms.intervention: same fully learned controller with a preregistered physical-law regularizer

held_constant: same seeds and training episode pools
same evaluation episodes within each seed
no fixed Boolean or operator table
no hand-coded address or retrieval function
no state or action labels in modalities
no post-run checkpoint, seed, hyperparameter, or metric selection

allowed_information: Hamilton's canonical equations dq/dt = dH/dp and dp/dt = -dH/dq
conservation of the learned Hamiltonian H on passive observation intervals
forbidden_information: masses, positions, velocities, or other physical-state labels
optimal action or target action index

leakage_rules: training and evaluation episode keys are disjoint for every seed and arm
evaluation fingerprints are distinct across seeds
both arms receive identical evaluation episodes within a seed
current audio contains speed magnitude only
goal text contains no action label
no physical state ground truth is passed to the model
physics loss is computed only from the model's own predicted state trajectory

primary_end_to_end_gate.description: A positive fully learned result requires the model to solve held-out action selection and discriminate matched-history pairs with identical current multimodal observations.

decision_rule.condition: all integrity gates pass; physics-prior mean accuracy >= 0.70; every seed >= 0.55; history-pair exact accuracy >= 0.70
decision_rule.licenses: bounded evidence of a fully learned end-to-end multimodal physical-control capability on the registered benchmark
decision_rule.does_not_license: real-world multimodal competence, general physical reasoning, general memory, learned semantic addressing, or scaling

decision_rule.condition: all integrity gates pass and physics-prior-minus-data-only delta >= 0.05 with bootstrap lower bound > 0
decision_rule.licenses: bounded evidence that the registered physical-law prior improves this learned end-to-end task
decision_rule.does_not_license: a universal benefit from physics priors

decision_rule.condition: integrity passes but end-to-end gate fails
decision_rule.licenses: the current fully learned model is not yet a demonstrated end-to-end solution on this benchmark

decision_rule.condition: any integrity or provenance gate fails

amendments.reason: Construct audit found that the first implementation allowed the action head to bypass the predicted physical-state pathway, so the physics-law prior was not guaranteed to regularize the representation used for action selection.
amendments.change: The learned action head now consumes the final predicted physical state directly, and a focused gradient gate verifies nonzero action dependence on that state.
unchanged: benchmark generator and held-out evaluation protocol
amendments.scientific_status: instrument-invalid before measurement; no result or artifact from this run may be interpreted or cited

amendments.reason: The first corrected model encoded an 8-dimensional two-particle physical-state head, which is a task-specific physical ontology rather than only a physical-law prior.
amendments.change: Replace the explicit two-particle state head with a generic learned canonical latent and a learned scalar Hamiltonian; regularize that latent only with Hamilton's equations and Hamiltonian conservation.
unchanged: benchmark generator and held-out evaluation protocol
amendments.scientific_status: instrument-invalid before a valid confirmatory artifact; no result from either run may be interpreted or cited

amendments.reason: Deterministic audio used a fixed particle-index phase offset, creating an unnecessary object-order sensor channel.
amendments.change: Deterministic audio is now permutation-invariant to particle order; the benchmark generator version is pinned to learned-physics-e2e-v2-no-object-order-audio.

amendments.reason: The generic canonical latent was still auxiliary to the action head, so a physics-prior update could in principle affect only a side branch.
amendments.change: The action head now consumes the final generic canonical latent directly; a focused gradient test verifies nonzero action dependence.
